_comment: Machine-readable 'graduatable watch-list': foundation skills still maintained full-impl in-house because NO vendor has cleared the curation bar yet (specs/dev-command-vendor-graduation §US-2 is the prose source of truth; this file is its machine mirror). scripts/curation-discover.sh tags any proposal whose repo path matches an entry's matchKeywords as a graduation candidate for that foundationSkill (graduationFor field). Tagging is LLM-free + deterministic and never lowers the trust/safety/judge bar. Adding/removing an entry here is the graduation-veille knob. matchKeywords are deliberately specific library names (precision over recall — 'auth' alone would match oauth/author).

entries.graduationTrigger: a Flutter-team or >=bar community agent-skill appears -> registry candidate -> REDUCE command, POINT agent
a neutral auth meta-skill of comparable breadth across better-auth/Lucia/NextAuth/Clerk/Supabase appears (else permanent)
a broad i18n vendor skill appears, or the pack narrows to Lingui-only -> POINT
